name: Team Rocket’s Wobbuffet

attacks.name: Rocket Frenzy
attacks.text: Reveal the top 6 cards of your deck. This attack does 30 damage for each Pokémon you find there that has “Team Rocket” in its name. Shuffle the revealed cards back into your deck.

flavor:
To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly
in the darkness. It is never first to attack.
